title: POST /{period}/trigger has no route-level test coverage
reasoning: The reviewed feature exposes an authenticated mutating endpoint that can start background digest generation and returns distinct 404 and 409 error paths, but the feature metadata lists no linked tests and the route implementation has no included tests covering success, missing schedule, lock conflict, or authentication behavior.
recommendation: Add focused FastAPI tests for this route using mocked scheduler lookup and digest generation: authorized success, unauthorized request, unknown schedule, and generate_digest returning None for 409.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The feature declares an empty tests list, and no linked test evidence was provided for this route.
suggestedRegressionTest: Add tests for POST /api/schedules/{period}/trigger that assert 200 with digest id when generate_digest returns a UUID, 409 when it returns None, 404 when get_schedule returns None, and auth rejection without the API key.
minimumFixScope: Tests only; no production code change is required for this finding.
